personality_one_liner: A sharp, tactical command center for vehicle diagnostics, using OLED-friendly darks and aggressive lime-green terminal accents.

spacing.rule: Dense but scannable, sharp metrics with compact margins. No excessive white space.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevated sections
dont's: No glass or blur. Keep it sharp and tactical for data density.

screens.name: Garage
screens.purpose: Overview of all personal cars with immediate visibility into expiring insurance or MOT.

states.empty: Technical illustration of an empty grid. Text: 'No vehicles in the garage.' Primary CTA 'Add Vehicle'.
states.error: Text: 'Unable to load garage.' Retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable list of car cards. Top section features 'Critical Alerts' for MOT/Insurance expiring within 30 days (highlighted with warning/error tokens). Car cards use a dense grid auto-layout: image on the left/top, sharp typography for Plate and Model, and right-aligned status dots.

screens.name: Diagnostics
screens.purpose: Global search terminal for vehicle trouble codes across all cars.

states.empty: Type a trouble code to scan the database.

screens.layout: Sticky search input at the top. Below, a list of matching trouble codes grouped by car and date. Use monospace-like alignment for the trouble codes (e.g., P0171).

screens.name: Add Car
screens.purpose: Form to input detailed car telemetry and details.
screens.layout: Single column form with labels above inputs. Fields: Producer, Model, Year, Engine, Insurance Expiry, MOT, Tyre type, Colour, Plate Number, Photo. Bottom-sticky 'Save Vehicle' CTA. Includes image picker for the car photo.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User settings and multi-user session management.
screens.layout: Simple list of settings, including 'Logout', 'Account Details', and app preferences.

screens.name: Car Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific car's specifications and diagnostic history.
screens.layout: Hero image of the car with top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Specs listed in a dense, 2-column grid. Below specs: 'Upload Xtool PDF' button, followed by a chronological list of past trouble codes. Sticky 'Upload' CTA.

hero_car_1.alt: Dark premium car in a garage

instructions_to_main_agent: The prompt suggested 'dark blue/cyan', but a real-time web crawl of sourceless.net verified their brand uses Neon Lime Green (#A7FF52) on deep dark backgrounds. The palette has been built around this verified data.
Follow 'Dark-First Utility' UI personality: avoid glassmorphism, use solid deep surfaces (surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary), and rely on sharp, aggressive contrast.
Use Phosphor icons heavily (filled for active, outlined for inactive).
Implement an alert banner component for MOT/Insurance expiring within 30 days.
Use 'brandPrimary' (#A7FF52) sparingly for accents, progress bars, and active states—treat it like an OLED dashboard highlight.
In the diagnostic history, render the trouble codes (e.g., P0171) in a high-contrast label/chip for easy scanning.
Ensure 'Upload Xtool Diagnose PDF' CTA is highly visible on the Car Detail screen.
